tools.name: list_calculator_bottles
tools.description: List all five supported US liquid medicine bottles, exact concentrations and public label-band identifiers. Use find_label_references for a named brand or ingredient. To read a listed row, pass its product_id, concentration and label_band to get_label_directions. No patient inputs. Minimal operation

tools.name: find_label_references
tools.description: Resolve ordinary public product names using bounded filters: Children’s Motrin means brand motrin and audience children; Zyrtec means brand zyrtec; generic cetirizine means ingredient cetirizine; Walmart means brand equate. Omit filters only when unspecified. An unlisted medicine or brand is unsuppo

tools.name: get_label_directions
tools.description: Read one printed public label row. Use exact identifiers from list_calculator_bottles or find_label_references.calculator_bottles; if already known, call directly without repeating discovery. Copy all three identifiers from the same bottle and one of its label_bands. Returns label amount or ask_doct

tools.name: list_question_guides
tools.description: Discover every published educational question guide, including symptoms, timing, food, bottle comparisons, label charts, Zyrtec chewables and Claritin. Returns public guide_id values, descriptions, update dates and canonical HTML/Markdown links. Use get_question_guide for complete content. No search

tools.name: get_question_guide
tools.description: Read the full published educational guide by exact public guide_id from list_question_guides. Markdown includes every paragraph, table, product/formulation distinction, source and safety limitation, identical to the website Markdown. updated is a content date, not clinical review.
